findings.title: Distinct-subject test also requires undocumented map insertion order
findings.reason: The new test compares Object.keys(refusalIds) with an ordered array. The locked contract requires distinct durable subject IDs and correct reason-to-subject/ledger mapping, not object-key iteration order. A valid implementation that accumulates the same two identities in another order fails this assertion. Replace the ordered comparison with set membership or sorted membership; retain the distinct UUID and exact ledger identity assertions below it.

findings.title: Plan source citations no longer identify the stated completion and Apply seams
findings.reason: The plan cites turns.ts:483 as fenced completion, but at pinned HEAD that line is an interface field; completeTurnFenced starts at src/lib/agents/operator/turns.ts:572. The neighboring Apply citations (292,412,476) now identify PolicyPlan, confirmation checking and writerRefusalResult rather than the collectively stated lock/writer/receipt seams. Refresh these current precedent citations with fully qualified paths and current symbols/lines. The underlying described behavior exists; this is stale navigation, not a false implementation claim.

findings.title: New Restore preparation invariant has a Sentry emitter without an alert rule
findings.reason: The new post-insert invariant throws "agents/operator: prepared Restore vanished in its transaction". The button route catches it at src/app/api/operator/proposals/[id]/restore/route.ts:38-40, emits reportCaughtError with endpoint api/operator/proposals/[id]/restore POST, and returns restore_failed 500. beta-launch-alerting.md contains no rule for this endpoint/invariant: its Operator Next.js rule at line422 explicitly filters the apply POST endpoint and retained-veto text; rule11 filters worker_job/agent_turn, which cannot match the button request. Add a matching operator-actionable invariant rule with identity, filter, error level, exception grouping, every-event cadence/throttle and destination action. This static finding does not claim a staging delivery drill occurred.
